payload.summary: Live freshness readouts round to whole hours, so a fresh fetch reads '0 hours ago'
payload.detail: resolveFreshnessFrom rounds ageHours to an integer, which suits a build-time stamp measured in hours or days. The ingestion panel's CheckedAt reuses it for a live fetch time, so a check two minutes old reads '0 hours ago' rather than 'just now'. Not misleading, but weak on the one page whose entire question is 'is it done yet'. Worth a minutes-and-seconds branch on the shared helper rather than a local workaround, since any future live panel will want the same.
